@@U02292@@
—My foot feels like lead.
—There a cramp in my arm.
—That’s gout.
—My big toe tickles.
—My whole back aches.
—This must be the biggest treasure trove ever.

@@U02294@@
Then hurry!
You wont slip away this time!
Prove your blathering lies are true!
Show us these noble chambers, now!
[ll lay down my sword and scepter and dig
with my own imperial hands and finish the job.
And if it’s a lie, I'll send you to Hell.

@@U02296@@
(Aside.)

@@U02297@@
I dare say I could find my way there, all right.

@@U02298@@
(Aloud.)

@@U02299@@
But I can’t stress enough the unclaimed wealth
waiting to be discovered everywhere.
The farmer plowing his field
turns up a pot of gold; scraping saltpeter
from its clay sides, trembling with joy,
he finds in his destitute hand
a roll of the purest gold.
As for that man with a nose for treasure,
what vaults there are to be blown open,
what clefts and passages must be passed through
to arrive at the region bordering the underworld!
There in spacious cellars long sealed off,
he will see row upon ordered row
of tankards of gold, bowls, plates,
goblets in abundance made of rubies,
translation:
@@U02292@@
——我的脚感觉像灌了铅。
——我的手臂抽筋了。
——那是痛风。
——我的大脚趾发痒。
——我整个背都酸痛。
——这一定是有史以来最大的宝库了。

@@U02294@@
那就快点吧！
这次你不会再溜了！
证明你的谎言是真的！
现在就向我们展示这些高贵的房间！
[我会放下我的剑和权杖并挖掘
用我自己的帝王之手完成这项工作。
如果这是谎言，我会把你送进地狱。

@@U02296@@
（旁边。）

@@U02297@@
我敢说我能找到路，好吧。

@@U02298@@
（大声）

@@U02299@@
但我怎么强调无人认领的财富都不过分
到处等待被发现。
农夫耕田
变出一桶金；刮硝石
从它的粘土侧面，因喜悦而颤抖，
他在他贫困的手中发现
一卷最纯的金子。
至于那个对宝藏有着敏锐嗅觉的人，
哪些金库会被炸开，
必须经过哪些裂缝和通道
到达与冥界接壤的区域！
在长期封闭的宽敞地窖里，
他将看到一行又一行的有序行
金酒杯、碗、盘，
大量红宝石制成的高脚杯，
